notes: Find Text now shows you where the hits are: every match is highlighted on the sheets, the view jumps to the first one, and you can click a hit off the drawing before turning the rest into a layer.

features: Find Text now highlights every hit on the drawing, and the page header shows its hit count
Click a highlighted hit to drop it before adding the layer - useful for a panel-schedule row that is not a device
Searching jumps to the first sheet with a hit, so the highlight is where you are looking
fixes: Find Text could report one fewer hit than the drawing contains when a mark from another layer sat near the label
